power_arithmetic_pin_down_REQUIRED: CONVENTION MISMATCH FOUND (must be resolved in-prereg before freeze): the mission's floor derivation 'sign tests at m=4 need raw p <= 0.0125 => n >= 8 all-wins pairs/task' holds only under the TWO-SIDED exact binomial (two-sided all-wins p at n=7 is 0.015625 > 0.0125; at n=8 it is 0.0078125 <= 0.0125). The mission's preferred-n justification 'n >= 10 gives adjusted p = 0.0039' equals 4 x 2^-10, i.e. the ONE-SIDED convention (one-sided n=10 all-wins raw p = 0.000977; two-sided = 0.001953 -> adjusted 0.0078). The two statements mix conventions; the prereg must PIN ONE convention and derive n from it.

HOLM STEP-DOWN vs UNIFORM THRESHOLD: requiring every task's raw p <= 0.0125 is stricter than Holm step-down (ordered thresholds .0125/.016667/.025/.05) and wastes power. Example at two-sided n=10: win pattern {10,10,9,9} -> raw ps {0.00195,0.00195,0.02148,0.02148} PASSES ordered Holm but FAILS a uniform-.0125 misreading. Prereg must spell out ordered rejection-with-stopping explicitly.

LOSS-TOLERANCE COMPOSITION TABLE (two-sided exact binomial, Scout-recomputed): n=8: ONLY {8,8,8,8} passes - ZERO loss tolerance anywhere. n=9: exactly one loss tolerated ({9,9,9,8}); {9,9,8,8} fails. n=10: up to 2 losses if no task drops below 9/10 ({10,10,9,9} and {10,10,10,9} pass; {10,9,9,9} fails). n=11: every task >= 10/11 - one loss PER TASK tolerated in any distribution ({10,10,10,10} passes: raw 0.01172 <= 0.0125). n=12: all >= 11/12, or exactly one task at 10/12. Under one-sided the tolerances shift by roughly +/-1 win. CONSEQUENCE: 'n >= 8' makes REPRODUCED_USEFUL reachable only under universal perfection - historically implausible given SCHEMA_MISMATCH, HTML-tier fallback failure, rb 418 and E2 wiring history across cycles 5-7.

RECOMMENDED COMMITMENT (cto_intel + critic convergence): schedule n=12 per task, require >=10 valid, commit the FULL tolerance table for the achievable valid-n range in-prereg; OR if Director sanctions a statistic change, exact task-stratified permutation test on paired log-speedups at n=10 (full enumeration 4096 patterns, seed committed) retains heterogeneity protection via per-task validity gates. Staying with the mission-named sign-Holm structure is fully compatible IF the table above is printed in-prereg and n is scheduled at 12 with >=10 required.

PAIR-VALIDITY SEMANTICS MUST BE FROZEN VERBATIM: harness/host-error pairs = mechanically INVALID exclusions (covered by oversampling); COMPLETED pairs where B is slower OR fails equivalence = LOSSES counted in the sign test, never excludable post hoc. Without this sentence the gate is gameable via silent relabeling.

F-stopping: mechanical anti-stopping apparatus - exact n committed as a NUMBER before first pair; seeded interleaved schedule + hash COMMITTED IN-TREE (fixes cycle-6 /tmp/opencode/c6_schedule provenance hole); append-only hash-chained execution log (prev-hash || pair-id || timestamps || outcome-class); predeclared invalidity taxonomy with detector code committed pre-freeze; replacement caps declared; pool exhausted => INCONCLUSIVE not USEFUL; optional blinding-by-construction via pseudonym salt hash committed pre-run.

F-D-decomposition: freeze B's tolerance policy FIRST, then define D-acceptance as matched to it (else circular); D-strict replicates c7 conditions; BOTH D variants built from independent dedicated captures preserving D-independence protocol; RECOMMENDED ADDITIVE (adoptable pre-freeze only): naive HAR byte-replay arm completing the {byte-replay, parameterized} x {strict-body, acceptance} decomposition (byte-replay success + D-acceptance success => pure packaging; byte-replay fail + D-acceptance success => parameterization content carries value; both fail where B succeeds => session/state effects dominate); retain privileged bare-HTTP C as unscored reference line; D-acceptance built MARKET-GRADE via ideas-only clean-room of strongest public methods (mitm2openapi UUID/hex detection, Browserbase browser-to-api templating) disclosed verbatim - a strawman D proves nothing about the market.

F-timing: warm-amortized timing as the gated metric (cold browser-launch inflation is how vendor 100x headlines arise); both cold/warm reported; identical retry/cache policies across arms; fix repetitions-per-pair and median-of-k given wall-clock noise on shared runners (closest task sits at 2.66x vs 2.0 gate - 33% headroom).

F-attrition: eligibility matrix predeclared (reachable-now, seedable data, direct-HTTP not WAF-blocked, schema-stable window); >=2 spare host-tasks screened through discovery BEFORE freeze; environmental death != instrument defect != pair-loss classifiers; m=3-survivor arithmetic placed in-prereg (Holm floor at m=3 is .016667: two-sided n=10 9/10 raw .02148 fails slot-1 but {10,10,9} pattern: .00195<=.016667, .00195<=.025, .02148<=.05 PASSES - a host death does NOT automatically kill the round; print this).

F-contamination: demoblaze doubled volume at n>=10 -> unique per-pair namespaces keyed by committed seed; structural/schema-normalized oracle (never ID/count equality); A/B interleaved minutes apart within pairs, never arm-blocked; ownership-scoped cleanup checkpoints; DB-state covariates logged.

F-drift: capture-time asset-hash fingerprints; predeclared classifier - replay failure WITH fingerprint diff = environment-invalid excluded-and-documented, WITHOUT diff = true loss; quiescence-wait constants hashed into config; NTP/UTC bookkeeping with evaluator recomputing eligibility.

F-verdict-template: carry M4 enum-meaning-flip blindness caveat into any USEFUL wording template (C4 is out of the verdict but its known blind spot must travel); scope claims to economics + parameterization dimensions; frame against honest external baselines (Playwright routeFromHAR canned-response substitution, JMeter/VuGen recorder-replay lineage, VCR/WireMock cassette-expiry analog) - never the vendor 100x headline.

F-guards-additive: tombstone-atomicity refusal guard; HTTP-client fingerprint logged per replay; optional binding-shift covariate; optional outcome-code taxonomy alignment with vendor PASS/ANTIBOT_BLOCK/PRODUCT_FAIL/AUTH_GATED categories for external comparability.

rationale_summary: Information gain maximal in BOTH directions and otherwise permanently lost: without a powered rule the cross-host economics question stays undecidable BY CONSTRUCTION while strong consistent per-task signals sit locked inside INCONCLUSIVE - the worst possible evidence state for a HIGH-relevance product lever gating R-2 Graph integration and Runtime capsule-schema decisions.

The genuinely uncertain clause is the redesigned C3' D-split (D-strict vs D-acceptance): nobody in the public ecosystem has answered capture-vs-declaration under matched tolerance policies; commoditization growth to ~13-14 implementations makes the packaging-vs-mechanism question MORE valuable to settle, not less.

Sunk-instrument asymmetry: harness reached P0-P7 end-to-end twice; marginal cost is volume on known-good plumbing; alternatives restart the never-executed-path defect cycle on less-understood mechanisms.
Hard-closure discipline is itself informative: whatever returns, the lane closes cleanly and queued candidates inherit a proven harness, two generations of anchors, and a decisive segmentation map.
